rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: CloudUxMCP provides AI assistants with direct access to Avid MediaCentral CTMS (Content and Traffic Management System) through a comprehensive MCP server implementation that handles authentication, system discovery, and asset browsing across PAM and MAM systems. Built with FastAPI and featuring both REST endpoints and WebSocket support, it integrates OAuth authentication flows, service root discovery, and hierarchical folder navigation, while including an OpenAI-powered chatbot interface that translates natural language queries into appropriate CTMS API calls. The implementation is particularly valuable for media professionals and developers working with Avid workflows who need AI-assisted access to production assets, project management, and media cataloging across multiple MediaCentral systems.
